I posted the draft as a reply in #strategic-random. It is not sent to Mateo.

- First report: 08:12, when SUP-5380 was opened and the reboot failed. The first post in #inc-vtg-hartford is 10:42 AM, so if procurement means the first report in the incident room, use 10:42.
- Kiosk 1 came back: 11:03 AM (trailer 8836 checked in).
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM, per your 11:08 update.

The draft also notes that Mateo's status-page access is still open (INC-4821) and that kiosk 2 stays powered on for Carrowmere's reconnect logs.
